startMessage.line1: It was just a throwaway line — so why does your heart drop?
startMessage.line2: "You look tired today," "That's just how you are" — they meant nothing by it, but the words loop in your head all day. You swallow it alone, scared they'll call you too sensitive.
startMessage.line3: What stings is different for everyone. Maybe an old memory got poked. Maybe it felt like rejection. Maybe an unspoken expectation missed. Maybe fatigue hit its limit. Or maybe your sense of worth wobbled. Your reaction shows your wound point.
startMessage.line4: These 10 scenarios show the real reason you get hurt — and how to protect your heart.
